Title: CRC-16 Byte Order Incorrect in Registration Response
Root_Cause: CRC-16/Modbus checksum was appended Big Endian instead of Little Endian in the registration response packet
Fix_Description: Corrected byte order to Little Endian in PacketAnalyzer; verified against hardware protocol spec
Remarks: Fixed same day during initial hardware testing

Title: TCP Listener Port Not Released on Application Restart
Root_Cause: TcpListener was not stopped and disposed on application shutdown; port 9999 remained in TIME_WAIT causing bind failure on restart
Fix_Description: Added proper StopAsync/Dispose in CircuitManager; used SetSocketOption(ReuseAddress) for quick restart

Title: Registration Packet DeviceName Parsing Off-By-One
Root_Cause: DeviceName field (16 bytes at offset 5) was parsed starting at offset 4; all subsequent fields shifted by 1 byte
Fix_Description: Corrected offset constants in HandleRegistrationAsync; verified all 33-byte field positions against PROTOCOL.md

Title: Session SQLite Directory Not Created Before DB Open
Root_Cause: SqliteBulkDatabaseManager tried to open DB file before creating the date-subdirectory path; threw DirectoryNotFoundException
Fix_Description: Added Directory.CreateDirectory(path) before SqliteConnection.Open() in BuildPath()

Title: Blazor UI Not Refreshing After Hardware Data Event
Root_Cause: OnDataChanged event fired from background thread; Blazor StateHasChanged must be called on the UI thread via InvokeAsync
Fix_Description: Wrapped all StateHasChanged() calls in InvokeAsync(() => StateHasChanged()) inside component event handlers

Title: UDP Listener Only Binding on Loopback Interface
Root_Cause: UdpClient was created with IPAddress.Loopback instead of IPAddress.Any; hardware UDP packets from LAN not received
Fix_Description: Changed UdpClient binding to IPAddress.Any for all UDP listeners on ports 10000 and 10001

Title: User Registration - Duplicate Username Not Handled
Root_Cause: Creating a user with an existing username threw unhandled DbUpdateException; no user-friendly error shown
Fix_Description: Added try/catch for DbUpdateException on user create; display validation message to admin

Title: ServerSessionStorage Key Collision Between Users
Root_Cause: Session storage key was built using only ComponentTitle without including UserName; two users sharing the same component would overwrite each other's state
Fix_Description: Changed key construction to UserName_ComponentTitle_DataTable ensuring per-user isolation

Title: ConfigurationEntity Missing Unique Constraint on Key Column
Root_Cause: ConfigurationEntity.Key column had no unique index; duplicate keys possible causing silent data corruption on read
Fix_Description: Added HasIndex(x => x.Key).IsUnique() in EF Core model configuration; added migration

Title: ServerSessionStorage Background Cleanup Not Running
Root_Cause: Background cleanup Task was started with Task.Run but not awaited as a proper hosted loop; cleanup never executed leaving expired items in memory
Fix_Description: Converted cleanup to a proper while(!token.IsCancellationRequested) loop with Task.Delay(interval)

Title: DBC Parser Crashing on Comment Lines
Root_Cause: DBC file parser did not handle comment lines starting with //; IndexOutOfRangeException thrown when parsing valid DBC files with inline comments
Fix_Description: Added comment line detection and skip logic at the start of the DBC line parser loop

Title: Program Step Binary Encoding Wrong Byte for Step Type
Root_Cause: ProgramBuilder was encoding StepType enum starting at value 0 but hardware expected it starting at 1; all step types shifted by 1 causing wrong hardware behavior
Fix_Description: Added +1 offset when encoding StepType byte in ProgramBuilder.BuildStepBytes(); verified against hardware firmware documentation

Title: TCP Command Timeout Too Short for Large Program Upload
Root_Cause: SendAndWaitForResponseAsync used 3-second timeout; programs with many steps required multiple 0xBB packets and exceeded timeout before final ACK received
Fix_Description: Increased TCP command timeout from 3s to 15s for program upload operations; applied per-command not globally

Title: Program Upload Stops at Step 5 - Off-By-One in Chunk Loop
Root_Cause: SendProgramStepsAsync loop used i <= steps.Count instead of i < steps.Count causing the last chunk to be sent twice and loop to stop after step 5
Fix_Description: Corrected loop boundary condition in step chunking loop

Title: DBC Binary Transfer to Hardware Padding Incorrect
Root_Cause: DBC binary chunk was not padded to match hardware expected packet size of 1400 bytes; hardware rejected partial final chunks
Fix_Description: Added zero-padding to final DBC chunk to reach 1400 byte boundary before sending

Title: Session SQLite WAL Mode Not Enabled
Root_Cause: SqliteBulkDatabaseManager opened connections without enabling WAL mode; under burst write load SQLite would lock and drop records
Fix_Description: Added PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL on connection open in SqliteBulkDatabaseManager

Title: AuditService Logging Null OldValue on Create Operations
Root_Cause: LogEventAsync passed null OldValue for Create operations causing JSON serialization to store literal null string instead of empty JSON
Fix_Description: Changed null OldValue to empty JSON object string {} for Create operations

Title: UserCircuitAccess Query Loading All Users N+1
Root_Cause: GetUsersWithCircuitAccessAsync was querying UserCircuitAccess inside a foreach loop over users causing N+1 database queries
Fix_Description: Replaced loop with single query using Include() and ToListAsync() in UserCircuitAccessRepository

Title: BatterySession EndTime Not Set on Stop Command
Root_Cause: StopProgram flow called session update but did not set EndTime field; sessions remained with null EndTime after completion
Fix_Description: Added EndTime = DateTime.Now assignment in ProgramServices.UpdateSessionOnStop()

Title: Calibration Buffer Returns Stale Data After New Calibration
Root_Cause: _calibrationBuffer array in CircuitCommandHandler was filled sequentially but index was not reset after reading; old entries mixed with new
Fix_Description: Reset buffer index to 0 and used circular write pattern; oldest entry replaced when buffer full (max 3 records)

Title: Device Discovery Multi-NIC Broadcast Race Condition
Root_Cause: BroadcastUdpService was sending broadcast on all NICs in parallel but single receive listener could miss replies if they arrived before listener was ready
Fix_Description: Changed to start listener first then send broadcasts; added small delay between broadcast sends per NIC

Title: Excel Export Missing DBC CAN Columns
Root_Cause: BmsExcelExport was built with hardcoded column list; dynamically added DBC signal columns in session SQLite were not included in export
Fix_Description: Refactored BmsExcelExport to read column names dynamically from DataTable source instead of hardcoded list

Title: Toast.razor Build Errors CS0101/CS8802/CS0426
Root_Cause: Inline __builder => lambdas used inside switch expression arms in Toast.razor caused CS0101 duplicate type and related build errors
Fix_Description: Refactored Toast.razor switch expression to standard if-else blocks; removed all inline lambda patterns

Title: Dockerfile ASPNETCORE_URLS Port Mismatch
Root_Cause: Dockerfile had ASPNETCORE_URLS pointing to wrong port; application container not reachable on expected port 5000 after docker compose up
Fix_Description: Set ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://+:5000 and corrected matching EXPOSE 5000 directive in Dockerfile

Title: GitHub Actions CI/CD Running on windows-latest
Root_Cause: Workflow used windows-latest runner which does not have Docker daemon; Docker build and push steps failed silently
Fix_Description: Switched workflow runner to ubuntu-latest which has full Docker support

Title: CI/CD Docker Push Job Missing needs Build Dependency
Root_Cause: Docker push job had no dependency on build job; could start before build artifacts were available causing flaky pipeline failures
Fix_Description: Added needs: build declaration to the Docker push/release job in workflow YAML

Title: CI/CD Docker Push Failing - Wrong Registry and Auth
Root_Cause: Workflow configured to push to DockerHub but credentials not set; GITHUB_TOKEN cannot authenticate to DockerHub
Fix_Description: Switched target registry to ghcr.io; used GITHUB_TOKEN for authentication; no additional secrets required

Title: CI/CD Missing packages:write Permission for ghcr.io
Root_Cause: Default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions do not include packages:write; push to ghcr.io container registry returned 403 Forbidden error
Fix_Description: Added permissions: packages: write to the GitHub Actions workflow YAML file

Title: CS0108/CS0114 Compiler Warnings in Repository Classes
Root_Cause: Repository implementation classes overrode base members without new or override keyword causing CS0108/CS0114 warnings at build time
Fix_Description: Applied new keyword where intentional hide is correct; applied override keyword where applicable; documented remaining cases

Title: RELEASE_NOTES.md Incorrectly Contains ICD Content
Root_Cause: ICD content was accidentally merged/pasted into RELEASE_NOTES.md during document authoring; two documents in one file
Fix_Description: Removed all ICD content from RELEASE_NOTES.md; file now contains release notes only

Title: QAP.md Incorrectly Contains CMP Content
Root_Cause: CMP content was accidentally merged/pasted into QAP.md during document authoring
Fix_Description: Removed CMP content from QAP.md; file now contains Quality Assurance Plan only

Title: INDEX.md Missing ARCHITECTURE_CAPACITY.md Entry
Root_Cause: New ARCHITECTURE_CAPACITY.md document added to Docs folder without updating the documentation index
Fix_Description: Added as entry #13 in INDEX.md; CMMI TS process area table updated

Title: DBD.md Missing Scheduler Tables and Migration Entry
Root_Cause: ProgramSchedules and ScheduleExecutionLogs tables created via EF Core migration were not documented in Database Design Document
Fix_Description: Added full table schemas and AddProgramScheduler migration to DBD.md

Title: RTM.md Missing FR-011 Scheduler Traceability
Root_Cause: Scheduler feature requirements had no traceability entries in RTM; CMMI REQM compliance gap
Fix_Description: Added FR-011 section with 10 traced requirements linking repository/service/implementation to test IDs
